subject: Request to shift POC evaluation window due to connector outage
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@clearline.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clearline.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline - connector outage and ask for short extension

Hi Jordan,

Quick update from our engineering side — an unexpected issue in the Clearline<>PaymentHub connector surfaced during end-to-end validation this morning. Our infra team traced it to a vendor patch that regressed message framing; they pushed a hotfix but it will take our backend team a few days to complete QA.

Because of this, we won't be able to complete the last two integration tests that were blocking the SLA and throughput checks in the current POC window. The original evaluation window ends next week. Can we request a two-week extension on the POC and a small sandbox credit top-up so our engineers can re-run the full suite after the fix?

We really want to keep momentum on this — team is aligned on Redwood's metrics, just need a little runway. I can share logs and the vendor report if that helps expedite an approval.

Thanks,
Samir Rao
Head of Integrations | Clearline AI
Phone: +1 415-555-0121

Attachment: integration-error-log.txt (text)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@clearline.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clearline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline - connector outage and ask for short extension

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and for sending the log. Sorry to hear about the vendor regression — totally understandable request.

We can support a two-week extension for the evaluation window. On credits: I can propose a one-off 25k token sandbox top-up to cover reruns of the workload and a short priority engineering queue to help revalidate once you have the fixes. I need to confirm formally with my manager for the credit amount; I’ll loop Marissa and Karthik to get sign-off and will follow up within 24 hours.

Could you confirm the earliest date your team expects to be ready for rerun and whether you need any guarded test datasets or additional logging hooks from us? That will help scope the support package.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 15:25:00 -0700
Subject: Request: approve 2-week POC extension + 25k token sandbox top-up for Clearline (DL-3492)

Marissa / Karthik —

Summary: Clearline AI (DL-3492) hit a vendor-side regression in their PaymentHub connector. They need ~2 weeks to fully validate a hotfix. They asked for an extension of the POC evaluation window and a small sandbox credit top-up to re-run integration tests.

What I'm proposing:
- Approve a two-week extension of the POC end date (shift evaluation window by 14 days).
- Issue a one-time 25,000 token sandbox credit to Clearline to cover revalidation runs.
- Provide priority engineering validation (2 x 2-hour sessions) from our Integrations Solutions team to speed verification.

Rationale:
- Deal is MQL -> clearly engaged; Clearline's engineers are already integrated with our SDKs and we have positive signal on inference latency and cost.
- This small concession should materially increase the probability of conversion to a paid Reserved capacity pilot; expected ARR from this account is ~$180k annualized.
- Keeping them in the active POC track avoids churn from a stalled evaluation.

Costs/Notes:
- 25k tokens ~ nominal (< $150 list equivalent), covered from AE discretionary credit band if approved.
- Priority validation requires a couple hours from our Integrations SEs (Karthik, please confirm availability next Wed/Thu).

Can you confirm approval (margin for AE to grant credits) or next steps for Finance/RevOps sign-off? If you want, I attached the vendor error log they shared and a short extension request form we can have the customer sign.

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachment: integration-error-log.txt, poc-extension-form.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: approve 2-week POC extension + 25k token sandbox top-up for Clearline (DL-3492)

Jordan —

Approve the 2-week extension and the 25k token sandbox credit. Condition: attach a short mutual action plan with dates and deliverables (owner + target completion) and have the customer sign the extension form. Also make sure the priority validation sessions are timeboxed to two 1-hour windows (not open-ended).

Karthik — please confirm you/your team can do two 1-hour validation slots next Wed (25th) and Thu (26th) mornings PST. If not available, propose alternatives.

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Rao <samir@clearline.ai>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@clearline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC timeline - connector outage and ask for short extension

Samir — good news: we approved the two-week extension and the one-time 25k token sandbox credit. Marissa asked that we sign a short mutual action plan and have the customer sign the attached extension form before we apply credits. I’ve attached the extension form and the mutual action plan draft to this message.

Next steps for Clearline:
- Reply with approvals/signature on the attached poc-extension-form.pdf.
- Confirm two 1-hour validation windows (we proposed Wed 08/25 09:00–10:00 PST and Thu 08/26 09:00–10:00 PST) — Karthik will be the SE on both sessions.

Once we receive the signed form we'll apply credits and lock in the validation slots. If you want me to adjust the times to your timezone I can.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-extension-form.pdf, mutual-action-plan-clearline.docx
